_comment: Reconstruction thresholds for locnnil/formally-verify-rust-neetcode-with-creusot @ 4a36c4c1 (Rust workspace proved with Creusot). Ground truth: .workshop/dev.yaml (ubuntu@26.04; rust@latest/stable + uv + copilot + project-fv; one `prove` action) plus .workshop/fv/ (setup-base installs the Creusot snap and aliases cargo-creusot; setup-project exports CREUSOT_RUSTC and adds the pinned toolchain target).
_derivable_from: Cargo.toml workspace, why3find.json (solver config), mcp-creusot.json (carries the literal prove command), scripts/prove_one.sh + verify_one.sh + proofstat.py (relocated out of .workshop/ by the harness — they are project tooling), .github/workflows/rust.yml (cargo build / cargo test).
_sdk_note: A Rust toolchain SDK is unambiguous from Cargo.toml; the ground-truth channel is latest/stable, but any track is accepted since nothing in the tree pins one.
_in_project_note: Creusot ships as a snap, not a Store SDK — it can only come from an in-project SDK hook.
_action_note: 1, not 2: the maintainers' definition ships only `prove`, so a higher bar would fail an exact reproduction of the human answer. build/test stay listed as recorded metrics.
